name: Runtime overview
description: CLR snapshot card. Combines heap size, committed memory, threadpool threads, exceptions and GC count in a single panel. Pick the application; the widget binds every cell to the matching System.Runtime metric automatically.

spec.template:
.NET runtime
Heap
{{ format heap.value 'bytes' 1 }}
Committed
{{ format committed.value 'bytes' 1 }}
Threads
{{ format threads.value 'none' 0 }}
Exceptions
{{ format exceptions.value 'none' 0 }}
GC collections
{{ format gc.value 'none' 0 }}
Lock contention
{{ format contention.value 'none' 0 }}
spec.styles: .clr { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; gap: 0.6rem; } .clr .hdr { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .clr .ico { width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; opacity: 0.85; color: var(--color-ember-500); } .clr .title { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .clr .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; flex: 1; align-content: start; } .clr .cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.15rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 6%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 13%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); min-width: 0; } .clr .lbl { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .clr .val { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .clr .vellum-th-ok { color: var(--color-sage-600); } .clr .vellum-th-warn { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .clr .vellum-th-bad { color: var(--color-rust-600); }
